Ask copy of charm.land/bubbletea/v2

Upstream:   https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea (module charm.land/bubbletea/v2)
Version:    v2.0.10
Module sum: h1:oolvo20VBpI0PfqE7iFjkZ1bx0WpmXGfnKz5Yldjq5o= (upstream v2.0.10; Ask go.sum had no entry before this copy)
License:    MIT (file LICENSE, unchanged)
Used by:    internal/tui and cmd/tui, through the replace line in the go.mod of the repository

What is here
  All non-test Go files of the module, go.mod, go.sum, LICENSE and one test file,
  replay_test.go, which guards the patch. The other upstream tests and the testdata
  folder are not copied. This folder is its own module: "go test ./..." from the
  repository root does not run it. Run: go -C third_party/bubbletea test ./...

The changes
  Four upstream files are changed and two files are new.
  tea.go            Program counts window size events (field resizeGeneration), puts the
                    count in the size message, and answers a replay request in the event
                    loop. A request for an old generation or an old size gets Stale.
  input.go          The size message is built from Width and Height only, because the
                    message has a new field.
  screen.go         WindowSizeMsg has a new field, Generation.
  cursed_renderer.go  Two changes in insertAbove (the code behind tea.Println), and one new method.
                    (1) A row that fills every column is not followed by erase-to-end-of-line.
                    After such a row the cursor sits on the last column with a wrap pending, and
                    the erase removed the last character. The line is blank after the insert, so
                    the erase is not needed there. Rows that end inside a line keep the erase.
                    (2) insertAbove sets the field cursorMoved. A commit leaves the terminal
                    cursor at the top of the frame, and a frame that did not change made the next
                    flush write nothing, so the cursor stayed there. flushLocked does not take the
                    "no changes" exit while cursorMoved is set; it then writes only the cursor
                    move (about 17 bytes with the show and hide sequences), not the frame.
                    New method replayInline: one synchronized write that clears the screen
                    and the scrollback, draws the startup text and the committed lines again,
                    and draws the live view. It does not acknowledge a commit.
  inline_replay.go  New. Public API: ReplayInlineTranscript and InlineReplayResult.
  replay_test.go    New. Renderer tests: the repair write, a full-width committed row keeps its last
                    character, and the cursor is placed again after a commit.

Why
  After a resize, an inline program cannot repair lines that the terminal reflowed in its
  scrollback. The program needs a way to redraw its committed lines in one atomic write.
  Upstream v2.0.10 has no such call.
  The two insertAbove changes let an inline program commit rows at the full terminal width and
  keep the cursor in its editor after a commit. Upstream v2.0.10 drops the last column of a
  full-width committed row and leaves the cursor at the top of the frame.

Guard
  internal/tui: TestInlineReplayPatchPresent uses the public API and reads the output
  through a terminal emulator. TestDependencyPins fails when the replace line or the
  Ultraviolet pin moves. replay_test.go tests the renderer inside the module.

How to update
  1. Download the new upstream tag (go mod download charm.land/bubbletea/v2@TAG) and copy
     its non-test Go files, go.mod, go.sum and LICENSE into this folder.
  2. Apply the changes above again. The patches (diffs against v2.0.10) are in
     the patches folder of this copy, one for each of tea.go, input.go, screen.go
     and cursed_renderer.go. inline_replay.go and replay_test.go are copied as they are.
  3. Keep Ultraviolet at the pin of the root go.mod, or test the new commit with the
     resize scenarios first.
  4. Run: go -C third_party/bubbletea test ./... and go test ./internal/tui/... ./cmd/tui/...
  5. Drop this copy and the replace line when upstream has an inline replay call.
